content.text: Vertical 9:16, cinematic, realistic. Daytime in Lisbon. A rideshare driver in his thirties sits in his parked modern compact car and looks at his smartphone showing a generic weekly earnings screen with a simple bar chart and a percentage figure. He frowns, zooms in with two fingers, then looks up thoughtfully through the windshield. Slow push-in, close-up over the shoulder, shallow depth of field, natural light. No logos, no readable text. --resolution 720p --ratio 9:16 --duration 5
